description: This file contains a unit test for the TextFragment and TextSegmentIterator classes, testing string manipulation functions such as trimming, searching, comparison, and iteration over string segments.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: A class representing a fragment of text, supporting operations like trimming, comparison, searching, and indexing.

classes.name: TextSegmentIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing segments within a TextFragment, with methods for iteration and reset.

methods.name: TextFragment (constructor)
methods.description: Constructs a TextFragment from a string, with optional start offset and length.

methods.name: Remainder
methods.description: Returns the remaining part of the text after some position.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current text segment the iterator points to.

methods.name: TrimBegin
methods.description: Removes the specified prefix from the TextFragment if present.

methods.name: TrimEnd
methods.description: Removes the specified suffix from the TextFragment if present.

methods.name: ReverseFind
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a substring.

methods.name: ReverseSkip
methods.description: Skips backwards to a specified substring.

methods.name: OnMarker
methods.description: Checks if the fragment is marked by the given buffer.

methods.name: EqualText
methods.description: Checks if the TextFragment's text matches the provided buffer.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison between TextFragment and buffer.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison between TextFragment and buffer.

methods.name: ForwardFind
methods.description: Finds the position of a delimiter in the text.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the content of the TextFragment.

methods.name: TextSegmentIterator (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes an iterator over segments of a TextFragment.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the initial position.
